cards.audioText: Do you have some advice about PEPEC?
cards.audioTextZh: 就PEPEC考试，你有什么建议吗
cards.referenceText: The test is a little bit difficult for me, but it is helpful for all the pilots and controllers. I hope the CAAC invest more manpower and material resources.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这个考试对我来说虽然有点难，但它对所有飞行员及管制员都有很大的帮助。我希望民航总局能够投入更多的人力及物力资源。

cards.audioText: Do you think you can pass the test this time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为这次你能通过考试吗？
cards.referenceText: I have made a lot of preparation for this test and tried my best to answer every subject just now. I will be very excited if I can pass the test this time, while if I failed, I would continue my English study. In short, whether I can pass the test or not, I believe I have done a good job.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我为这次考试做了许多准备，刚才我也努力回答了所有问题，如果能通过这次考试我会非常高兴。但是如果没有通过，我会继续学习英语。总之，不论我是否能通过，我相信这次我已经做得很好了。

cards.audioText: How do you think of the PEPEC system?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得PEPEC考试系统怎么样？
cards.referenceText: Every coin has two sides. PEPEC system is a pressure for us, it can also improve our English level. We will benefit from the PEPEC sooner or later.
cards.referenceTextZh: 任何事物都有两面性。PEPEC考试给我们压力的同时，也提升了我们的英语水平。我们迟早会受益于它。

cards.audioText: Do you think the ICAO English test is difficult? Which part is the most difficult for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得ICAO英语测试难吗？你觉得哪一部分最难？
cards.referenceText: A little difficult for me, especially Part 2. Because I think it's hard for me to remember so many sentences in a short time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对我来说有点难，尤其是第二部分。因为我觉得我很难在短时间内记住这么多句子。

cards.audioText: Are you satisfied with your performance today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对自己今天的表现满意吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I feel good in the test. I've tried my best in the last months, so I believe I can smile at the result whatever I fail or pass this time. And I hope I'll be the lucky dog.
cards.referenceTextZh: 满意，我感觉我在考试中表现得不错。上个月我尽全力复习，所以不论是否能通过，我都会微笑面对考试结果，希望我可以幸运地通过考试。

cards.audioText: Which part is the most difficult for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 对你来说考试哪一部分最困难？
cards.referenceText: The first part of listening test is much more difficult, because some details of dialogues are hard to handle for me. Besides, the third part of oral test is also difficult because some aviation knowledge and emergency situations are easy to understand and express in Chinese while difficult in English, but I believe that practice makes perfect. The more we practice, the easier it becomes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 听力考试的第一部分比较困难，因为对话中的一些细节对我来说不容易听懂。此外，口语考试的第三部分同样比较困难，因为使用中文时，那些航空知识和紧急情况很容易听懂或表述出来，但使用英文时就很困难。但是我相信，熟能生巧，我练习得越多，考试对我来说就会越容易。

cards.audioText: Is this the first time for you to take the PEPEC test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这是你第一次参加中国民航飞行人员英语等级考试(PEPEC)吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, it is. /No, it's the second time.

cards.audioText: Do you have something to say before finishing the test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在考试结束前有什么想说的吗？
cards.referenceText: I would like to give thanks for your time first, and I've found that my English remains to be improved. Through this test, I deeply realize that English plays an important role in radiotelephony communication. I will make more efforts to improve my English skills in future. Thanks for the test and thank you again.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我要感谢你在考试中为我花费的时间，还有就是我发现我的英语仍有提升空间。通过这次考试，我深深体会到英语在陆空通话中的重要性。未来我会更努力地提高自己的英语水平。感谢这次考试并再次感谢你。

cards.audioText: How do you think of today's test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得今天的考试怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I'm not pleased with my performance. Though I have made good preparations for it, I'm not in good test condition because of poor sleep last night. / I feel good in today's test. The listening test is easier than I practiced before and the subjects in the oral test are all familiar to me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我不太满意我的表现。虽然我做了充分的准备，但是昨晚没睡好导致今天状态不佳。/ 我感觉不错。听力部分比我之前练习的简单一些，口语部分的话题我都很熟悉。

cards.audioText: Do you have confidence to pass the test?
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think I have tried my best and I hope I can pass it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为自己已经尽力了，我希望自己可以顺利通过。

cards.audioText: How do you think of this Oral Proficiency Interview by computer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对通过电脑进行的口语能力面试怎么看？
cards.referenceText: Generally speaking, this is an advanced test approach. It is more convenient and effective, and I'm less nervous when I take the test by computer instead of face-to-face test. In addition, such kind of test is really helpful for improving my oral English and professional knowledge. It should be much better if we have more efficient training materials to be familiar with the test, such as some guidance books or some regular training courses.
cards.referenceTextZh: 总的来说，通过电脑的考试方法很先进，这种方法更方便、高效。和面对面的考试相比，通过电脑考试减轻了我的紧张程度。此外，这样的考试对于提高英语口语和专业知识的水平真的很有帮助。如果我们能有更好的培训材料来熟悉考试会更好，例如一些辅导书或是定期培训课程。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between this test and other kinds of tests?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试和其它类型的考试有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: This is the only test I have taken and I am not in a position to make a comment, I am afraid. / This is the first test I've ever taken that we make the oral English test by a computer. The test method is new and suitable for pilots and controllers. Meanwhile, I feel more relaxed to speak facing a computer than to speak face-to-face with a strict real person.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是我第一次参加这种考试，恐怕没办法回答这个问题。/ 这是我第一次用计算机做口语测试。这种测试方式很新颖，适用于飞行员和管制员。同时，面对计算机说话比和严肃的人面对面交流让我更放松。

cards.audioText: What do you think of PEPEC test?
cards.referenceText: I think the PEPEC test is necessary for pilots, especially for those who fly international flights, it will improve our radiotelephony communication in English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得PEPEC测试对飞行员非常有必要，特别是那些飞国际航班的飞行员，它能够提高我们的英语无线电陆空通话水平。
